additional_info.body:
Hello,
We are sorry for the incorrect information.
It was mentioned in the KA that it can be resolved by making some changes in SCB which is incorrect. We have updated the same on KA as well.
This feature has still not implemented. Based on recent communication from R&D team this feature will be available in FW v6.0.x which will be available in 2nd week of 2025.
These higher consumption is due to EMC filters available in AC circuit.
Please let me know if you have any other question or can we close this ticket?
Awaiting your response.
Thank you.
